text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through 
the Twinkle Series with my partner 
Umamusume would begin. The name of the 
girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"You are the one who summoned me, the 
Supreme Overlord, T.M. Opera O, aren't 
you?!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Then I shall answer the call. For it is 
my mission to illuminate everything to the 
far reaches of the horizon with this 
strength and beauty!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, we depart! Follow me—! 
Ha-ha-ha-ha-ha!!

And so, our challenge for the Twinkle 
Series with <chrname> began!
